LLM Engineer | advanced AI & intelligent systems

Are you passionate about transforming cutting-edge AI research into real-world business value?

We're looking for an experienced LLM Engineer to join an innovative AI and Intelligent Systems team driving digital transformation within a highly automated, technology-driven manufacturing environment.

Your impact:

In this role, you'll design, fine-tune, and deploy large language models that automate complex business processes and support critical operations. You'll collaborate closely with stakeholders, software engineers, and data specialists to identify high-value opportunities, build proof of concepts, and scale successful solutions into enterprise-grade applications.
Key responsibilities

• Develop, fine-tune, test, and optimize LLMs for production environments

• Design and implement NLP solutions that deliver measurable business impact

• Translate business requirements into scalable AI, data, and software architectures

• Build AI agents, skills, and integrations for modern AI platforms

• Develop MCP servers enabling secure data access and controlled automation

• Lead proof-of-concept initiatives from ideation through implementation

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to embed AI capabilities into existing systems

• Contribute to next-generation AI-assisted development workflows using tools such as GitHub Copilot and Claude Code

What we're looking for

• Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field

• 7+ years of relevant industry experience

• Strong experience with NLP, LLMs, and transformer-based architectures

• Proficiency in Python and/or C++

• Hands-on expertise with Hugging Face, PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, Spacy, or similar frameworks

• Experience with Langchain, agentic workflows, and AI application development

• Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and modern software engineering practices

• Excellent communication skills and the ability to engage with both technical and business stakeholders

• Fluent in Dutch and English

What makes this opportunity unique

This position offers the chance to work at the ForeFront of applied AI, developing solutions that move beyond experimentation and create tangible value at scale. You'll be part of a forward-thinking team shaping AI strategy, driving adoption, and building innovative systems that define the future of intelligent operations.

jobs.description:
Your Mission

We are looking for an experienced hospitality professional who wants to do more than simply serve drinks.

As the face of the bar during the evening, you will play a key role in both the operational and strategic development of Jill's F&B experience. You will actively contribute ideas and initiatives to increase revenue, attract local customers and create memorable guest experiences.

You will be part of the strategic thinking behind the evolution and dynamisation of the bar, helping transform it into a true lifestyle destination.

Key Responsibilities

• Deliver exceptional and personalized service at the bar.
• Create a warm, welcoming and lively atmosphere for guests.
• Develop sales through natural upselling and product recommendations.
• Animate and energize the bar area while ensuring an outstanding guest experience.
• Contribute to the development of drinks, mocktails and food offerings.
• Promote Jill's Sober Life philosophy and signature products.
• Participate in the organization of afterworks, events and micro-activations.
• Organise, coordinate and manage the weekly Thursday afterworks, ensuring a vibrant atmosphere, excellent guest engagement and smooth event execution.
• Manage daily bar operations, stock levels and service quality.
• Serve the evening food menu, including pasta dishes, sharing boards and other light options.
• Provide room service upon guest request, ensuring timely, professional and courteous delivery of food and beverages.
• Monitor performance and proactively suggest initiatives to increase revenue.
Key Performance Indicator (KPI)

Your primary KPI will be the growth of bar and F&B revenue through:

• Increased average spend per guest.
• Development of local clientele.
• Stronger guest engagement and loyalty.
• Successful activation of the bar and terrace experience.
• Enhanced visibility and attractiveness of Jill's F&B offering. 
Profile

• Minimum 2 years of bartending or bar management experience.
• Previous hotel experience is a strong advantage.
• Passion for hospitality and guest engagement.
• Strong commercial mindset and entrepreneurial spirit.
• Ability to create atmosphere and build customer loyalty.
• Creative, proactive and solution-oriented.
• Comfortable working independently while contributing to a team environment.
• Interest in lifestyle, design, food & beverage, art and hospitality trends.
• Multilingual: English is mandatory. Other languages are a strong asset.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. 
 

What We Offer

• The opportunity to build and shape a growing F&B concept.
• Active involvement in the strategic development of the bar.
• A creative, human-centered and inspiring work environment.
• A dynamic and entrepreneurial team where ideas are encouraged.
• The chance to make a real impact on the future of Jill's hospitality experience.
At Jill, we're looking for more than a bartender. We're looking for a host, an ambassador, a storyteller and a hospitality entrepreneur who can transform a hotel bar into a vibrant destination.
